label_printing.print.error.busy: The label printer is already printing. Try again in a moment.
label_printing.print.error.unavailable: The label printer is not reachable. Check that it is switched on and paired.
label_printing.print.error.image: The label image could not be prepared for printing.
label_printing.print.error.printer: The printer reported a problem and did not finish the label.
label_printing.print.error.unexpected: The label could not be printed.
label_printing.print.error.noBarcode: This product's variant has no barcode, so there is nothing to print. Add a GTIN to the variant first.
label_printing.print.error.noVariant: This product has no active variant to print a label for.
label_printing.print.error.ambiguousVari: This product has several variants and no default one, so the label would be ambiguous. Mark a default variant first.
label_printing.print.error.unsupportedGt: This variant's identifier type cannot be printed as a barcode.
label_printing.print.error.render: The barcode could not be rendered onto the label.
